note: Where tty Emacs 30.2 really draws its cursor: the terminal's cursor after a redisplay, read through term.el (probe/screen4.el). `cursor` is a byte offset here. posn-at-point reports a wide character that moved whole, or a control character with no cell left on its row, at the column it left, as wrap.json shows, but the cursor is drawn on its new row. probe/screens2.sh and probe/screens3.sh made these.
